# University of Warwick

> A leading Russell Group research university offering world-class education, research excellence, and global partnerships across multiple disciplines.

The University of Warwick is a prestigious UK institution known for its strong research output (92% world-leading research in REF 2021), diverse postgraduate and undergraduate programs, and strategic business partnerships. The university emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration, regional engagement in the West Midlands, and alumni community building through initiatives like the Set the Pace campaign.

## Core University

- [Welcome to University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk): University of Warwick homepage showcasing study, research excellence, and global opportunities
- [University of Warwick: About the University and Campus](https://warwick.ac.uk/about): University overview, rankings, Russell Group membership, and contact information
- [Rankings and Reputation](https://warwick.ac.uk/about/reputation): University rankings and reputation metrics across QS, Times, and Complete University Guides

## Study and Education

- [Study with us at the University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/study): Main study portal offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional training programs
- [A to Z of our postgraduate courses at Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses): Postgraduate course directory with masters programs in accounting, finance, and sustainability
- [Economics and Environmental Policy (MSc)](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-economics-environmental-policy): MSc program in environmental economics and policy from top-ranked Department of Economics
- [Social Sciences at Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/c/social-sciences): Faculty of Social Sciences degree programs and career development resources
- [Undergraduate Open Days at University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/undergraduate/opendays): Open day bookings and campus visit information for prospective undergraduates

## Research and Excellence

- [Research at the University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/research): Research hub featuring research culture, spotlights, and interdisciplinary collaboration
- [Warwick's REF 2021 results | University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/research/ref/results): Research Excellence Framework 2021 results showing 92% world-leading research quality
- [News](https://warwick.ac.uk/research/news): Research news covering business innovation, AI systems, and behavioral science breakthroughs

## Business and Partnerships

- [Warwick Business Partnerships | University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/business): Business partnerships and knowledge exchange with organizations like GSK and BAD
- [Engagement](https://warwick.ac.uk/engagement): Global and regional engagement strategy for West Midlands and international partnerships

## Alumni and Community

- [University of Warwick Alumni and Supporters](https://warwick.ac.uk/alumni): Alumni community hub featuring networking, benefits, and Set the Pace Campaign
- [Set the Pace | Alumni and giving](https://warwick.ac.uk/alumni/set-the-pace): Set the Pace fundraising campaign targeting £250m and 20,000 volunteering acts by 2030

## Campus and Visitor Services

- [Your Campus Journey](https://warwick.ac.uk/visit): Campus navigation guide covering travel, parking, and visitor information
- [Student accommodation & housing | Warwick Accommodation](https://warwick.ac.uk/services/accommodation): On-campus and off-campus student housing across Coventry and surrounding areas

## News and Updates

- [News | University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/news): Press releases and news articles covering research, partnerships, and university announcements
